<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that forms an amide from a carboxylic acid (or its activated derivative) and an amine, breaking the C=O bond of the acid and forming the C–N amide bond.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic_acid"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
